授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
Course announcements will generally be made through the Moodle course page, so students are encouraged to check it regularly.
Students interested in the course are strongly encouraged to attend the first class.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: AIの急速な発展が経済・社会・労働市場にどのような影響をもたらすかを、社会情報学と経済学の視点から考える。理論的な枠組みを学びつつ、最新の研究論文を読み解くことで、AI時代の政策課題について批判的に考察する力を養う。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: This course examines the economic and social implications of artificial intelligence from a social informatics perspective. Students will engage with key theoretical frameworks and recent empirical research, with a focus on labor markets, data, and digital platforms. Through presentations and discussions, the course aims to develop the ability to critically evaluate research and policy debates related to AI.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: AI, labor economics, technological change, productivity, employment, empirical research
